play: (async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const S = window.__strat; if (!S.snap()) document.querySelector('#v-play [data-a=start]').click(); await w(300); let s = S.snap(); if (s.pub.phase === 'setup') { document.querySelector('#v-play [data-a=ready]').click(); } for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !(S.snap().pub.phase === 'play' && S.snap().myTurn); i++) await w(100); window.__plyBefore = S.snap().pub.ply; const m = S.legal()[0]; S.act({ type: 'move', from: m[0], to: m[1] }); })()
played: (() => { const s = window.__strat.snap(); return !!s && s.pub.ply >= window.__plyBefore + 2 && s.myTurn; })()
debug: JSON.stringify((() => { const s = window.__strat.snap(); return s ? { phase: s.pub.phase, ply: s.pub.ply, before: window.__plyBefore, myTurn: s.myTurn } : null; })())
